name: @psyb0t/rankrat
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted rankrat server over MCP — Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, GA4, PageSpeed and IndexNow as tools.
description: Connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to rankrat over either transport. By default it runs the published psyb0t/rankrat image and speaks MCP down its stdio, so no server needs to be running first; set RANKRAT_TRANSPORT=http to proxy to an already-running server's Streamable HTTP endpoint at RANKRAT_URL/mcp instead. Exposes whichever tools that server publishes: Search Console analytics, summaries, comparisons, trends, anomalies and drop attribution; URL inspection, sitemaps, crawl issues and crawl stats; Bing keyword statistics, ranking buckets, opportunity and cannibalization reports; GA4 realtime, content, landing-page, traffic-source, ecommerce, audience and conversion-funnel reports; PageSpeed Insights and schema fetching. rankrat is read-only by default; a server started with writes enabled additionally publishes IndexNow submission, Bing and Search Console URL/sitemap/property changes, Google Indexing notifications and new-site onboarding. The tool list reflects that server's configured providers and settings, not a fixed catalog. rankrat is self-hosted — see https://github.com/psyb0t/rankrat.

RANKRAT_TRANSPORT.description: "stdio" (default) runs the published image; "http" proxies to a running server.

RANKRAT_CONFIG_DIR.description: stdio transport: host directory holding boundaries.json. Required for stdio.

RANKRAT_SECRETS_DIR.description: stdio transport: host directory holding provider credentials.

RANKRAT_OAUTH_DIR.description: stdio transport: host directory holding the stored Google OAuth token.

RANKRAT_IMAGE.description: stdio transport: image to run. Defaults to psyb0t/rankrat.

RANKRAT_URL.description: http transport: base URL of the running server, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp). Required for http.

RANKRAT_AUTH_TOKEN.description: http transport: bearer token value, when the server was started with a bearer secret configured.

RANKRAT_READ_ONLY.description: stdio transport: forwarded to the server. Defaults to true there; set false only for a deliberately writable session.

RANKRAT_UNBOUNDED.description: stdio transport: forwarded to the server. Trusted onboarding mode; requires RANKRAT_READ_ONLY=false.

transport.description: Run the published image over stdio, or proxy to a running server over Streamable HTTP.

secretsDir.description: stdio: host directory holding provider credentials.

oauthDir.description: stdio: host directory holding the stored Google OAuth token.

url.description: http: base URL of the running server, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp).

authToken.description: http: bearer token value, when the server requires one.
